memories.content: Each member has their own reasons for or against standing for chair. Some may be interested, others not. No member has yet volunteered.

The Kettlewell allotment society's chair is stepping down. Nominations for the new chair close at the annual general meeting in five weeks, on 2026-09-29. The society has a membership who can volunteer to stand for chair.
